description: Prioritized upgrade plan for one project (project_path): the 4DA app's work order when computed (per-line targets, manifest vs lockfile fix), else the smallest version that fixes each vulnerability. Call when the user asks what to upgrade.

package.description: Plan for this one package only (exact name, any ecosystem). Default: every dependency.

project_path.description: Project directory to plan for: the app's plan is narrowed to the steps (and installed lines) that touch it; the standalone plan resolves that project's lockfiles. "*" for every project the app tracks. Default: the project the server was started in, when that directory is a project.

risk_threshold.description: Only show upgrades at or above this risk level. Default: all

name: upgrade_planner
title: Upgrade planner
